why: Charts and static pages read one set of viz colours. Five categorical, five sequential steps and the neutral roles must be derived and gated, not hand-picked, so a retune cannot ship an unreadable ramp.
what: packages/basalt-ui/src/tokens/chart-vars.ts (new) with test. packages/basalt-ui/src/css/chart*.css is optional: create it only if a static page needs a rule the vars cannot carry, otherwise the PR says the glob stays empty. Outside-owns edits: one call site in src/tokens/emit.ts so the Viz values come from chartVars(config), and the regenerated src/css/tokens.css and src/tokens/golden/** (regenerate with their documented commands, never by hand).
contract: docs/v3/concepts/tokens-visual.md sections 3.2 (Viz row, 14 names) and 8 (S1-S4); docs/v3/concepts/static-framework-free.md section 3 row 10 and falsifier F-S5.
exemplar: packages/basalt-ui/src/guard/palette.ts and src/tokens/divider-contrast.test.ts (2.x contrast gates over derived colours); scripts/gen-chart-css.ts shows how the 2.x charts root block is generated.
change: chart-vars derives line, dim-bar, grid, crosshair, chart-1..5 and seq-1..5 per scheme from the same config as the rest of tokens.css, and exposes them to emit.ts (the JSON emit of v3-tok-t4-cli reads the same exports). table.ts keeps the 14 Viz NAMES (tok-t2's registry): the row is fed by chart-vars, not replaced, and never edited here. Gates, each failing with gate, surface and ratio: every chart-N and seq-N mark >= 3.0:1 on canvas and inset; dim-bar >= 3.0:1 on inset; seq-1..5 monotonic in lightness per scheme; seq-1 >= 1.3:1 on the dark inset without leaving the accent hue (F-S5); chart-1..5 pairwise distinct under the colour-vision check the 2.x series-palette audit uses. Names are exactly tokens-visual 3.2; no new name. Rule: none (zone A list is v3-tok-t4-cli's). Skill snippet: none. Test: chart-vars.test.ts over the default seed and a hue-268 seed at vibrancy 0, +1, +2.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
acceptance: bun test packages/basalt-ui/src/tokens/chart-vars.test.ts passes for both seeds in light and dark
A seeded config with seq-1 below 1.3:1 makes the emitter throw naming the gate and ratio
chart-1..5 and seq-1..5 appear in the emitted CSS and the generated VX types, exactly once each, with the derived values
The public --vx-* name count does not rise above the 90 ceiling
out_of_scope: Series groups and defineSeries (charts concept), argo's 93 pairs, Tailwind bridge, ramp hexes (internal, hex-identical, never exported).
